original_v3_final: sealed; excluded from all v4 splits; its source image files were not opened or rehashed by this job

quality_rule.use: descriptive and train-only curation; never used to exclude development, calibration, evaluation, or presentation images

selection_rule.candidate_pool: v3 development-role SurvFace identities only; v3 train, v3 calibration and sealed v3 final identities excluded from known-roster selection
selection_rule.historical_exposure: all five selected identities and images were in v3 development. This v4 public benchmark is exploratory; it is not a fresh confirmatory set.
ranking_order: number of source camera groups with at least ten quality-valid unique image groups, descending
minimum eligible group count among covered camera groups, descending
numeric source identity as lexical tie-break

split_grouping: exact checksum and existing within-identity pHash<=6 candidate groups are kept within one role; filename camera groups are strata, not capture sessions; sessions are unknown.

training_gallery_parity.gallery_role: train records; no extra permitted information
training_gallery_parity.train_selection: quality-valid groups only, ranked by quality score within filename-camera groups with hash-based tie break; applied only to the training role. All verified images remain eligible for other roles.

unknown_roles.class_balance: 300 OTHER train images total matches the 300 known training images; downstream batches must sample five known classes and OTHER with equal class weights.
